name: Just Listed
description: The Just-listed email to everyone on the list, in English or Spanish (whichever they signed up in). It shows her newest listing that is For sale or Coming soon and not Private, so there is nothing to edit: add the home, then send. To send: Bulk Send at the bottom of this page, Collection Just-listed Subscribers. Each template reaches each subscriber only once, ever. For the next home, Duplicate this template, give the copy a new name, and send the copy.
subject:
{%- set l = cms.collection.objects('listings')|filter(x => x.mine and not x.private|default(false) and x.status in ['for-sale', 'coming-soon'])|sort((a, b) => b.listedOn|default('') <=> a.listedOn|default(''))|first -%}
{{- data.lang|default('') == 'es' ? 'Nueva en el mercado: ' : 'Just listed: ' }}{{ l.address -}}
